parts.text:
When a solution of $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ in molten cryolite is electrolysed, aluminium metal is formed at the cathode. The equation is shown.

$$\text{Al}^{3+} + 3\text{e}^- \rightarrow \text{Al}$$

Give your answer to two significant figures.
